name: Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant energy of the Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang, located on Hon Tre Island, the place where your Nha Trang paradise awaits. Enjoy the timeless Indochine-style architecture, luxurious hotel accommodations and villas, culinary delights, private and pristine beaches, and turquoise waters, or venture out for thrilling adventures at the all-in-one amusement park VinWonders. Simply relax by the pool, rejuvenate at our Akoya spa, or enjoy exclusive access to the Imperial Club featuring fine Chinese cuisine, fresh seafood, or fun at Karaoke or the Bowling alley. Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang caters to every desire, even boasting state-of-the-art meeting and convention facilities ideal for any business functions or weddings.

The quintessence of international cuisine
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang offers a diverse and rich culinary experience, from international buffets loved by the whole family, Mediterranean-style cuisine in the luxurious restaurant Jasmine that boasts endless sea views, to creative cocktails at the Beach Comber Bar, all of which will bring authentic experiences of true enjoyment for families, couples, and guests on business trips.
Lotus Restaurant
Breakfast: 6:00 - 10:30
Lunch: 12:00 - 14:00
Dinner: 18:00 - 22:00

(+84) 258 359 8222

(+84) 258 359 8222
